name: links
description: Reusable helpful-links primitive. customJS.Links.parse(value) normalizes a note's `links` frontmatter (array of {url,text}|{url,label}|{href,text}, bare-URL strings, or a JSON string) into an ordered, de-duplicated [{url,text}] (text defaults to url; entries without a url dropped). customJS.Links.render(dv, {links, title?, empty?}) renders the read-only list of external anchors (target=_blank rel=noopener) in added order, cold-load safe. First wired into the project blueprint's per-project Link Hub note; generic so daily/meeting/other notes can adopt it later.
